summary: OnlyFans Autopilot MOCK phase testing complete. All backend and frontend tests passed (36 backend + 25 frontend = 61 total). Mock publishing works correctly with MockOFProvider, queue advancement verified, security requirements met, and all other modules unchanged.
passed_tests: Backend: Auth protection - all 11 endpoints require admin JWT (401 without token)

Backend: GET /status returns correct contract (OF_AUTOPILOT_STATUS=PAUSED, MOCK_MODE=true, OF_REAL_POSTING_ENABLED=false, AUTO_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false, REAL_POSTING=OFF, AUTO_SCHEDULER=OFF, PROVIDER='The Only API', CONNECTION_STATUS=CONNECTED, ACCOUNT_USERNAME=latosegreto, ACCOUNT_STATUS=HEALTHY, THE_ONLY_API_REAL_WRITE_CALLS=0, OF_REAL_POST_DONE=false)
Backend: GET /status settings correct (posts_per_day=3, schedule_times=['11:30','17:30','22:00'], timezone='Europe/Rome')
Backend: GET /status queue present (total=10, position=1, cycle_number=1, order with 10 models)
Backend: GET /status schedule.next_slot.slot_id starts with 'of_' and ends with time (11:30/17:30/22:00)
Backend: GET /preview returns PREVIEW status with public.side=PUBLIC, secret.side=SECRET, SAME_MODEL_MEDIA=true, media_order=['PUBLIC','SECRET']

Backend: POST /publish-now media objects complete (processId, host, thumbId, name present in both public and secret)

Backend: POST /real-posting returns 404 (route does not exist)
